item.title: Episode 1: The Box
item.description:
During 2020, thanks to funding from the Arts Council of Wales’s National Lottery Fund, Daniel researched traditional stories that seemed to address some aspect of the strange year we have lived. During the last few months of the year, he will release a story every Sunday at 8pm (starting 22nd November) and they will be available via this podcast. This is the 1st episode and it is called "The Box".

Gwnnaethpwyd y podlediad hwn yn bosibl trwy arian gan y Gronfa Loteri Genedlaethol drwy Gyngor Celfyddydau Cymry.

item.title: Episode 2 - The Sword of Wood
item.description:
A new telling of a traditional story - from storyteller Daniel Morden and musicians Sarah Moody (cello) and Oliver Wilson-Dickson (violin).
Produced by Oliver Wilson-Dickson
To donate please visit: www.thedevilsviolin.co.uk/donate

item.title: Episode 3 - The Magic Well
item.description:
Here is a new telling of a traditional story, once told by the Wood family in North Wales. Storyteller Daniel Morden with musicians Sarah Moody (cello) and Oliver Wilson-Dickson (violin). Produced by Oliver Wilson-Dickson To donate please visit: www.thedevilsviolin.co.uk/donate
Thanks!

item.title: Episode 4 - The Snake of Dreams
item.description: A traditional tale retold with music by The Devil's Violin. Storyteller Daniel Morden, Cello Sarah Moody, Violin Oliver Wilson-Dickson. Produced by Oliver Wilson-Dickson. Thanks to Hugh Lupton, from whom Daniel first heard this story.

item.title: Episode 5 - Isaac
item.description: Welcome to another traditional story - retold with original music by The Devil's Violin. Daniel Morden (storyteller) Sarah Moody (cello) & Oliver Wilson-Dickson (violin / producer). You can find out more about us at www.thedevilsviolin.co.uk where you can download this and other stories and also donate for this podcast. Cheers!

item.title: Episode 6 - Spellbound
item.description: This enchanting story is told to you by Daniel Morden, with Sarah Moody on Cello and Oliver Wilson-Dickson on violin / production. Find out about our live shows, recordings and donate for the podcast at www.thedevilsviolin.co.uk

item.title: Episode 7 - The Devil & The Gypsy + Fill The House
item.description: Two for the price of one! Retellings of two traditional stories with storyteller Daniel Morden and musicians Sarah Moody (cello) and Oliver Wilson-Dickson (violin / viola / production). Enjoy / share and if you can donate at www.thedevilsviolin.co.uk
